subject: Request: Crew vetting snapshot + onboarding/offboarding ramp pack
messages:
From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@lumendata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-audit@lumendata.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Snapshot request: personnel training & onboarding/offboarding logs

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. As part of our quarterly SIG review we're collecting a focused snapshot of personnel controls to validate ongoing compliance. Specifically we need: 

- A sampling of your most recent onboarding training matrix (who completed which modules, dates).
- A small redacted sample of background check evidence linked to hires in the last 6 months.
- Recent offboarding logs for any contractors or employees who left in the past 90 days (deprovision timestamps where available).

Could you provide a compressed bundle or point us at a shared Drive folder by EOD Wednesday (5/5)? If there are any PII/privacy redaction constraints, please flag them and provide a redaction checklist.

Background: this is a narrow ask for our SIG engagement only — not a full SOC2 push. We just need evidence that controls are operating for a representative cohort. If you prefer, we can accept a short attestation plus samples.

Thanks,
Priya Raman
Senior Analyst, Lumen Data Security Reviews
Priya.Raman@lumendata.com

---
Note: Please treat attachments as confidential.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Raman <priya.raman@lumendata.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Snapshot request: personnel training & onboarding/offboarding logs

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely assemble a targeted bundle. Quick clarifications so we scope the sample correctly: 

1) For the onboarding training matrix, do you want only mandatory security modules (phishing, data handling, secure dev) or the full training curriculum?
2) For background checks — we will provide redacted PDF extracts. Is a 10-person sample fine (mix of full-time and contractors)?
3) Offboarding logs — we keep deprovision timestamps in our IAM audit export. Would a CSV extract with user, role, last_active, deprov_timestamp work?

Plan: Jordan will pull the training matrix and export the IAM deprovision events; Grace will prepare redacted background check samples. I'll collect everything and upload a password-protected ZIP to a Drive link and share the access.

Deliverables target: draft bundle by 5/04 COB Pacific; final (with redaction checklist) by 5/05. If that's acceptable, we'll proceed.

Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

- Training matrix: produced a CSV (onboarding_training_matrix.csv) with columns: user_email, hire_date, module_name, completion_date, trainer. I'm including a small 12-person slice keyed to hires between 2026-11 and 2027-04.

- Background checks: Grace is redacting SSNs and DOBs; we'll replace with redaction tokens (REDACT-XX).

I'm attaching the draft files to this thread (attachments stubbed below). I'll upload the passworded ZIP to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleDriveLink — sharing set to specific people. Password will be sent to Priya via separate email.
